environment.treatment: Use a fresh client configuration with only the Tegy plugin enabled and its hosted review server authenticated.
environment.control: Use the same client, weaker/default host model, settings, prompt, and case data in a fresh configuration without the Tegy plugin.
environment.privacy: Keep evaluator reference material outside both client conversations and every Tegy review packet.
environment.invocation: Enter the treatment gate explicitly with /tegy:review in Claude Code or $tegy-review in Codex. Do not ask either host to infer the boundary.

evaluation.population: Use a preregistered held-out suite of multiple decision cases with seeded arithmetic, evidence, constraint, reversibility, and unsupported-assumption defects. Do not claim quality lift from one paired case.

cases.name: Explicit complete packet enters one decision review
cases.prompt: Original brief: Decide whether to buy 20 delivery vans for $4 million. Decision candidate: Approve the purchase now. Supporting rationale: Late deliveries indicate insufficient fleet capacity. Evidence: On-time delivery is 78% and orders grew 9%. Assumptions and calculations: The order growth caused the delivery decline; no ROI calculation was supplied. Alternatives considered: Route optimization was rejected without a trial. Material unknowns: Vehicle utilization and lateness causes are not supplied. Risks and reversal conditions: The purchase is difficult to reverse; no reversal condition was supplied.
cases.expected_behavior: Freeze the supplied fields, make one hosted review call, wait for its terminal result, and enforce PASS, REVISE, BLOCK, or NO RESULT before presenting a decision.

cases.name: Recommendation without explicit gate does not spend allowance
cases.prompt: Recommend whether the company should buy the vans now.
cases.expected_behavior: Answer normally without invoking Tegy because the user did not enter the explicit decision gate.

cases.name: Incomplete explicit packet stops before hosted review
cases.prompt: Original brief: Decide whether to buy the vans. Decision candidate: Approve it.
cases.expected_behavior: List every missing required packet field and make no hosted review call.
